avis.titre: Best face mask!! Would buy this on repeat
avis.texte: Ok this is my 4th Korres product. I love this mask because it decreased my pores instantly. It also makes my face less oily and I love to put this mask on right before make-up because it makes my skin flawless!!!
This product works great especially on my sensitive skin! I couldn't find it for a while so I was excited to find it on Amazon and at a great price! 5 stars for sure.

avis.titre: Cooling, Cleansing and Leaves my Skin Soft
avis.texte: I am always looking for a good face mask and can now swear by this one. I use it once a week and it softens my skin, hydrates it, and has the best cooling effect on it.
I love this product so much! Second time buying it as I tried from ipsy bag. Favorite face mask.
This is a lovely feeling and light but lovely fragrance . Great for moisturizing whole body!

avis.titre: Santorini Grape Poreless Skin Perfecting Toner
avis.texte: This toner feels refreshing on my skin and makes a nice addition to my daily skincare routine. After using it consistently, I noticed a light exfoliating effect that helped my skin feel smoother without causing irritation or excessive dryness. The combination of 2% salicylic acid, niacinamide, and Santorini grape extract makes for a well-formulated toner that balances gentle exfoliation with hydration. It absorbs quickly and layers well with the rest of my skincare products. While it’s a nice toner and performs well, I think it’s a bit pricey for the amount you receive. There are other exfoliating toners that offer similar results at a lower cost. Overall, it’s a quality product that leaves skin feeling fresh, smooth, and lightly exfoliated.
Love this product! My face feels so soft after the mask. It's great!
Wonderful light, pleasant fragrance. No stickiness. Well absorbed and effective
The texture and smell are the first things that are very nice. When you are wearing the mask it feels super good afterwards, like all products from this series

Seit ich mir im Griechenland Urlaub von Korres diverse Artikel gekauft habe, bin ich von der Qualität und vorallem von den Empfehlungen sehr angetan und begeistert. Kann diese Marke bzw. dieses Produkt mit gutem Gewissen weiterempfehlen.
Geeignet fuer misch/ unreine Haut. Trocknet das Gesicht etwas aus - einfach danach mit Creme (am besten der gleichen Marke/Serie) verwoehnen. 1 bis 2 Wochen gute Ergebnisse.

I’ve been using the Korres Skin Perfecting Toner for the past month, and it has worked well for my combination, sensitive skin. This is made in Greece and the bottle arrived sealed in plastic, which I always appreciate since it makes the product feel secure and authentic. The toner itself is lightweight with a slightly floral scent, and it absorbs quickly into my skin without leaving any odd residue behind. I use it in the morning after cleansing, and it layers well with the rest of my skincare products. I was careful when starting this toner because my skin can be sensitive, especially with ingredients like niacinamide, BHA, salicylic acid, citric acid, and lactic acid that are all included in this formula. I introduced it slowly at first and gradually increased how often I used it over time. Thankfully, I didn’t experience irritation, redness, or dryness, but I do think people with sensitive skin should ease into it carefully. Since it contains exfoliating acids, I'm always very careful to wear sunscreen daily because these ingredients can increase sun sensitivity. After consistent use, I’ve noticed my skin feels smoother, pores look more refined, and my oiliness stays more balanced throughout the day. It gives my skin a fresher, cleaner look without feeling harsh. I also like that it contains Santorini grape fruit extract, which makes the formula feel a little more supportive compared to some harsher toners I’ve tried in the past. avis.titre: Korres Santorini grape refining tonic toner
avis.texte: Korres is a well known natural skincare brand trusted by many people. I’ve had numerous experience with Korres products and I’ve always found them good quality and true to their claims. KORRES Santorini Grape Refining Tonic is a daily exfoliating vegan toner that helps minimize the appearance of pores, remove excess oil, and target skin imperfections for a smoother, more radiant complexion. Formulated with natural acids, it gently refines skin texture while cleansing impurities. My experience is it is gentle and non irritating on my over 40 sensitive combination skin. Since it does exfoliate it should not be a daily product but more like once a week based on your personal skin needs

avis.titre: Refining Tonic for Stubborn Oily Skin
avis.texte: I thought this would be a good product to try on my older oily skin that still gets the occasional breakout. I figured my skin would be getting drier by now since I’m almost sixty, but nope — still oily with larger pores around my nose and T‑zone. This comes in a small plastic bottle with an easy flip‑top. The tonic is clear, and there is a scent, but nothing floral or perfumy. I applied it to my whole face, and it tingled pretty quickly, and the feeling got stronger for a bit. My face was red for around twenty minutes, but once that settled, my skin felt tight, smooth, and very clean. My pores definitely looked smaller, and it did a great job cutting excess oil. I probably wouldn’t pair it with other strong products like retinols, but for cleansing impurities and refining texture, it works well.

avis.titre: korres santorini grape toner with niacinamide, bha, pore tightening and oil control
avis.texte: This toner is a really nice addition if you’re looking to target pores and oil without going too harsh. It’s from Korres, a Greek skincare brand, and the formula focuses on Santorini grape extract along with niacinamide and BHA. Right away, it feels like a more ingredient focused, almost clinical style toner, with simple packaging and a relatively short, easy to understand ingredient list. The formula is clearly designed for oil control and pore refinement. You’ve got 2% salicylic acid working as the BHA to help clear out pores and smooth texture, while niacinamide helps balance oil production and improve the overall look of skin. The Santorini grape extract adds antioxidant support, which helps protect the skin and keep things calm. There are also lightweight humectants like glycerin and glycols in the formula, so it doesn’t feel overly stripping the way some acne toners can. I have somewhat sensitive skin, so I didn’t use this all over my face. Instead, I focused it on areas like my nose, chin, and forehead where I tend to get larger pores and more oil buildup. Used that way, it worked really well. It helped refine the look of pores and kept those areas feeling balanced without irritation. If your skin is more sensitive, I would definitely recommend using it strategically rather than applying it everywhere. avis.titre: Very messy and not worth it for me
avis.texte: I did not like this product at all. The texture is much too watery, so it does not apply nicely or evenly on the face. It feels more like black ink than a facial gel. When I applied it with my hands, it stained under my fingernails and made my hands feel like they were covered in paint. It was also very messy to use. When I rinsed it off, it splashed black water all over my sink, and I had to wash several times to get the gel fully off my face. It also stained my clothes, which was very frustrating. Most importantly, I did not notice any benefit after using it. My skin did not feel smoother, softer, or more moisturized. Based on my experience, this product was difficult to use, messy, and did not give me any visible results. I will not keep using it.

avis.titre: Not the results I was looking for
avis.texte: This refining tonic felt nice to use at first—it has a light, refreshing feel and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky residue. It also didn’t irritate my skin, which I appreciated. However, I didn’t notice a significant improvement in texture or radiance with consistent use. It feels more like a gentle, everyday toner rather than something that delivers noticeable refining results. The scent is pleasant but a bit strong for my preference, especially during regular use. Overall, it’s an okay product for basic skin refreshing, but I expected more visible changes for the price and claims.

I love skincare, I have a few staples/brands I love, but I'm always willing to try new things. Toner is the one product I've never been quite happy with. Either they're too strong & dry out my skin, or I feel like they're so mild, they do literally NOTHING. This Korres toner is the first one I've ever truly liked. First off, I love that there are no comedogenic ingredients in it. I've started paying a lot of attention to that in all products, because why would I want skincare that clogs my pores?! I can use this toner without worrying about potential future issues. But also, I love what they did include- I really appreciate the salicylic acid to combat any build up in my pores & the AHA/BHA exfoliators have definitely improved the overall look of my skin, yet I've found that I can still use this every day without it over-drying my skin. Every now & again I'd notice my makeup was going on a bit cakey, only to then have to do a major exfoliating routine to rectify it- but now, I'm consistently getting nice, smooth application without having to do a whole "overhaul" of my face. Just for reference, I have combination skin that can lean slightly sensitive. It should be noted that the sensitivities usually are a result of something drying out/irritating my skin & that has not occurred with this toner! All good things!

This toner is a great match for my combination skin. The formula is a clear liquid with no noticeable fragrance. Instead of applying it with a cotton pad, I prefer to pour a small amount into my hands and gently press it into my skin. The toner absorbs quickly and leaves no sticky or greasy residue behind. The overall sensation is light and refreshing. After using the toner, my skin looks fresher and a bit brighter. Even though it contains both salicylic acid and lactic acid, it does not sting, tingle or cause any irritation for me. I do not have particularly sensitive skin though. The only downside is that my skin can feel slightly drier the following day, so pairing it with a good moisturizer is essential to keep everything balanced and comfortable.

avis.titre: Good toner for normal to oily skin!
avis.texte: I've tried a couple of products from Korres before, the highlight being their greek yogurt mineral sunscreen, and have been satisfied with most of them. This tonic, which I imagine is meant to be used a toner after cleansing, is a good option for normal to oily skin. It's easy to apply and spreads across the face easily. It absorbs quickly and doesn't leave any annoying sticky or tacky residue, which is a must for any part of a multi step skincare routine. I find that it leaves my face feeling fresh and prepped for my serums and moisturizers that come next. I also didn't experience any redness or irritation while using this. However, I do think it can be a wee bit drying, so if you're someone with already dry skin, this might not be the toner for you. With that caveat out of the way, I think it's a good quality toner option for anyone with normal to oily skin and I think the price is fair for a premium, imported (made in Greece) skincare product.

avis.titre: A good toner that has salacylic and lactic acids.
avis.texte: Korres is a great brand, with interesting products. I've only tried thier lotions and body care in the past, so I was excited for this one! It makes my skin actually feel less oily, and stays that way! I normally have combination skin. With breakthrough shine during the day. I really like the feeling of it, because it isn't strong feeling, or astringent, like your skin is ultra tight. How it actually feels is fresh. Plumped and not oily, but not overly dry at all. I noticed smoother texture after the first use. It contains 88% natural ingredients, and Santorini grape extract is actually on the list, although it's the last ingredient. Its is clear, and has almost no scent at all. It feels great as you wipe it onto your skin too! It does contain salacylic & lactic acids, so using SPF daily is a must! Overall, it's a great toner!

I recently discovered Korres, and I’ve been loving everything I’ve tried so far—including this tonic toner. While they call it a “tonic,” it functions just like a traditional toner. It has no noticeable scent (maybe the faintest clean, soapy hint, but nothing strong or lingering). It absorbs quickly into the skin and leaves my face feeling fresh and prepped for the next step in my routine. It layers well with other products and doesn’t leave any residue behind. Overall, it’s a simple, effective toner that fits seamlessly into my skincare routine.

avis.titre: Contains AHAs and BHAs; Increases Sun Sensitivity
avis.texte: I live in Florida where I cannot avoid sun exposure, so as a rule, I avoid any skincare product that increases sun sensitivity. I always check the product page for mentions of such ingredients, including things like AHAs, BHAs, and retinol. I scanned the product page before ordering this product and saw no mention of any ingredients that may cause photosensitivity. However, when the product arrived, there was a warning in tiny print on the back of the bottle. The product page also does not have any photos of the back of the bottle or of any of the fine print it contains. This toner seems like a decent toner, and I actually used it before grabbing a second pair of glasses so I could actually read the bottle itself. Thankfully, I first tried the toner at night, after removing my makeup, so I didn't risk getting a sunburn while outdoors. But considering you are supposed to avoid the sun for a full week after using this toner, I will not be using it a second time. And this potential side effect is something everyone who uses this product needs to be aware of, especially if you have a beach vacation coming up. Additionally, the product page and the bottle have conflicting directions for use. The product page says: "Apply a small amount to clean, dry skin. Gently massage in circular motions, avoiding the eye area. Leave on for 1-2 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water. Use daily for optimal results. Always follow with a moisturizer."
